claim: The 14-day refund window is counted from delivered_at; an order delivered 2 days ago but created 20 days ago must still be refundable.
Refunds are only allowed for orders with status 'delivered'; a placed order must receive 400.
A refund amount greater than the order total must return 400.
A refunded order cannot be refunded again; a second refund request must return 400.
A successful refund returns 200 and sets the order status to 'refunded'.
